patch_description:
This revision keeps the effective batched simplex search but improves the late-stage acceptance rule: during the final search phase, candidates are selected lexicographically by the true minimum normalized triangle area first and by the lower-tail mean second. This prevents soft-min optimization from sacrificing the actual bottleneck triangle.

It also records several strong independent restart configurations and applies deterministic SLSQP maximin polishing with fixed local orientation signs. The polish directly maximizes the minimum normalized determinant subject to all triangle-area and simplex constraints, allowing the final configuration to balance active constraints more accurately than random local proposals alone. A cached result avoids repeated optimization work.
